description: This Java class 'KeyStoreFactory' provides methods to create and configure a Java KeyStore, including initialization, setting private keys, and adding certificates, used internally for SSL/TLS security setup.

classes.name: KeyStoreFactory
classes.description: A utility class to create and manage Java KeyStores for SSL/TLS configuration.

methods.name: newKeystore
methods.description: Creates and initializes an empty KeyStore.

methods.name: setPrivateKey
methods.description: Sets a private key and its associated certificates into the KeyStore.

methods.name: setCertificate
methods.description: Adds a certificate entry to the KeyStore.
